purpose: Prevent a slow diagnostic save from publishing success for an expired collection request.

baseline.path: receiveDiagnostic validated request identity/state/expiry before invoking storage, then unconditionally published a receipt and RECEIVED state after storage if trust still held. The polling download path uses this shared function too.
baseline.reproduction: FAIL in both deterministic synctest cases: a save completing one nanosecond beyond the 1-minute request lifetime revived the request as RECEIVED, both without a status poll and after a status poll had already made it EXPIRED. A success receipt and path were also published. No physical minute-long disk stall was reproduced.

change.validation: Extract validateDiagnosticReceiveLocked and reuse the same request/receipt rules before storage and under diagnostic.mu immediately before success publication. No network or storage I/O runs under this lock.
change.publication: An expired, mismatched or non-PENDING collection cannot be marked RECEIVED or publish a new success receipt/path. The existing receive slot is released on rejection.
change.cost: Reuse the existing content digest; no additional body read, hash pass or save callback. The additional validation scans at most the existing 32 receipt records plus constant-time request checks.
change.interfaces: Preserves the existing request lifetime, HTTP routes, response status codes and JSON schemas. No DB, installer, repository hygiene, task runner or source-of-truth document changes.

validation.regression: PASS: both expiry cases reject the late save, preserve EXPIRED, publish no receipt/path, release admission, and allow a new collection and its exact replay with one save callback.
validation.focused: PASS: TestDiagnostic suite, 4.530s, including replay identity/content, post-save revocation, receive admission, upload deadlines and request correlation in both network roles.
validation.packages: PASS: go test -timeout 3m ./internal/peerupdate ./internal/residentagent, 11.304s and 6.816s, using Go 1.27.3 with the repository runtime STW overlay.
validation.hygiene: PASS: changed Go files formatted with gofmt; git diff --check.
validation.skipped: Full repository, frontend, installer/release packaging and physical two-PC acceptance: only internal diagnostic success publication validation changed, with no installed program update.

remainingRisk: The save callback may already have created a file before the final rejection. This change rejects late success publication; it does not preempt filesystem I/O or delete callback-owned output. Historical input-service recovery and cursor handoff problems were not exercised.
